items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I had some of the boys in my band... A trumpet player named Freddie Jarman(?) and one named Robert Davis who played tenor

ctx.x: Well, they'd try to play and couldn't do it (?). I had some of the boys in my band... A trumpet player named Freddie Jarman(?) and one named Robert Davis who played tenor -- he's an insurance executive up here on Forrest Avenue right now.
